#### Description
- Added missing check to prevent IBAutomater restart after `Dispose` is called

#### Related Issue
Closes #4807 

#### Motivation and Context
- IBAutomater restarting after IB Dispose

#### Requires Documentation Change
No.

#### How Has This Been Tested?
- Tested fix locally with algorithm included in #4807
